### Headline summary
- OpenRouter removed three AI providers after researchers found attackers had stolen data from inside the firms for months. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/openrouter-ai-chat-leaks/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openrouter-drops-3-providers-after.html))
- A patched Ghostscript flaw allows crafted files to escape the sandbox and execute commands on systems running WordPress and Linux print servers. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/upload2shell-flaw/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/researchers-demonstrate-ghostscript.html))
- The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of its key national criminal justice database. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/fbi-investigating-apparent-hack-of-its-key-national-criminal-justice-database-ap-source-says/))

### OpenRouter removes providers after prompt theft
OpenRouter removed three AI hosting providers and revoked Zero Data Retention eligibility after researchers discovered that attackers had stolen data from inside the firms for months. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/openrouter-ai-chat-leaks/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openrouter-drops-3-providers-after.html))

### Ghostscript sandbox escape flaw affects multiple apps
A patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the security sandbox and execute commands on systems running WordPress, Roundcube webmail, and Linux print servers. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/upload2shell-flaw/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/researchers-demonstrate-ghostscript.html))

### FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says
The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a national law enforcement database that it maintains. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/fbi-investigating-apparent-hack-of-its-key-national-criminal-justice-database-ap-source-says/))

### Hackers Exploit Microsoft Entra Connect Health Flaw to Access Admin Emails and Organization Data
Attackers exploited a flaw in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to read administrator and technical contact email addresses, along with configuration data from affected organizations. A Microsoft customer notice shared on Reddit describes read-only access to those records, not access to inboxes or ema… ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/microsoft-entra-connect-health-flaw/))

### Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cleverbridge-warns-hackers-stole-credit-card-numbers-cvvs-in-data-breach/))

### GL.iNet Owners Find a Second Backdoor on Their Routers, Some Planted in 2025
Owners checking their GL.iNet routers for Friday’s cloud attack have found a separate, older backdoor, on some routers since the autumn of 2025. It isn’t in GL.iNet’s security notice of 20 November, and the check GL.iNet tells owners to run doesn’t find it. ([Privacy Affairs](https://www.privacyaffairs.com/glinet-router-backdoor/))

### Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/chainflip-12m-crypto-hack-10-percent-bounty?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound))

### USDA Cyber Incident Disrupts Farmer Payments
A cyber incident at the USDA disrupted farmer loan and payment services. Security experts warn that agriculture remains exposed to wider cyber risks. ([HackRead](https://hackread.com/usda-cyber-incident-disrupts-farmer-payments/))
